# usage register

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:usageRegister`](gmeow-usageRegister.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/usageRegister>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/names`](../../slices/names.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The social register of a name-usage (formal, intimate, professional, casual) — a [`gmeow:NameRegister`](../classes/gmeow-NameRegister.md) value individual.

## Structure

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:NameUsage`](../classes/gmeow-NameUsage.md) -> [`gmeow:NameRegister`](../classes/gmeow-NameRegister.md); functional

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:usageRegister`](gmeow-usageRegister.md) from [`gmeow:NameUsage`](../classes/gmeow-NameUsage.md) to [`gmeow:NameRegister`](../classes/gmeow-NameRegister.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Common Companion Terms

[`gmeow:NameUsage`](../classes/gmeow-NameUsage.md), [`gmeow:NameRegister`](../classes/gmeow-NameRegister.md)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to record the social register of a [`gmeow:NameUsage`](../classes/gmeow-NameUsage.md) — whether the name is used formally, intimately, professionally, or casually.

### Avoid when

- Avoid carrying register on the appellation itself (register is a fact of the USE, not of the name) and avoid inventing a free-text register — reference a [`gmeow:NameRegister`](../classes/gmeow-NameRegister.md) value individual.

### How to use

- Set [`gmeow:usageRegister`](gmeow-usageRegister.md) once per [`NameUsage`](../classes/gmeow-NameUsage.md) (functional) to a [`gmeow:NameRegister`](../classes/gmeow-NameRegister.md) individual; mint one (formal, intimate, professional, casual) per (appellation, audience, register) tuple of a usage.

### Examples

- ex:usageFamily [`gmeow:usageRegister`](gmeow-usageRegister.md) [`gmeow:registerIntimate`](../individuals/gmeow-registerIntimate.md).
